messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx error rate from eu-west-1 detected by routing-slo-monitor. P50 latency spike +50%, 5xx spike 18% over baseline. Automated traffic-shift to eu-west-2 started at 1765439998.
Sam: I'm seeing a big bump in health-check failures for embeddings-svc in eu-west-2, worker pool OOM-ish logs. Not healthy.
Lia: Paging oncall. I'm taking lead. @Oncall-Net can you confirm routing control-plane state?
Oncall-Net: I’m on it. Checking route-controller and DNS status. Early impression: route-controller shows both eu-west-1 and eu-west-2 marked as AcceptingTraffic simultaneously. Possible split-brain during shift.
Devon: That's bad — we might be steering traffic to nodes that aren't fully drained. Do we have a recent traffic-shift job id?
deploy-bot: TRAFFIC SHIFT job 69741 started by autopilot @1765439998 -> targets: eu-west-2 (50%), eu-west-1 (50%). status: partial-complete (some endpoints failed).
Maria: Observed DNS TTL for service endpoints is 300s but some upstream caches still honoring old records. Also seeing stale routecache entries on edge proxies.
Lia: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause any in-flight traffic-shift jobs 2) set routing to eu-west-1 (original primary) only 3) flush route-controller cache 4) drain eu-west-2 nodes gracefully 5) reduce DNS TTL to 60s. Agreed?
Sam: +1. Pause shift now please.
Oncall-Net: Paused job 69741 via control plane: `POST /api/v1/shift/69741/pause` -> 200 OK.
Devon: Changing routing policy: setting region-preference to eu-west-1-only (manual override). Command: ``curl -XPOST $CTRL/api/v1/route-policy -d '{\"policy\":\"region:eu-west-1\",\"priority\":1000}'`` Doing it now.
Oncall-Net: Policy pushed. route-controller reports active_policy=eu-west-1-only.
Maria: Flushing route cache on edge: `kubectl -n edge-system exec -it route-cache-ctl -- /bin/flush-cache --all` -> job queued.
Sam: Begin graceful drain of eu-west-2 workers serving embeddings-svc: `svcctl drain --region eu-west-2 --selector role=worker --timeout 600s`
deploy-bot: DRAIN job 69742 queued for eu-west-2 workers.
Lia: Running quick traffic verification after policy flip. Sam, Maria, watch logs for 5xx and latency.
Sam: Early telemetry — 5xx rate dropping to 6% (was 18%), p50 latency trending down but some spikes persist from old caches.
Devon: Noted that route-controller metrics show concurrent masters briefly at failover time — filing cloud-provider ticket for controller split at 1765439902.
Maria: DNS TTL lowered to 60s across control plane. Propagation in progress. Also opened ticket with CDN vendor to purge caches for service domains.
Oncall-Net: Cloud provider responded: 'we saw control-plane election timeouts in eu-west region due to AZ network degradation' — they are investigating AZ interconnects.
Lia: Customer impact assessment: embeddings/generation APIs for EU clients experienced ~20-40s errors and 2-3x latency for ~45 minutes for a subset of routes. Estimated affected customers: 240 accounts (top 10% of call volume).
Sam: We should notify support and CS for customer comms. Lia, can you draft a short update?
Lia: Drafting now: "Incident update: We experienced partial region failover in EU region; traffic was shifted while some nodes were unhealthy, causing elevated errors and latency for EU customers. We've paused the automated shift, forced routing back to primary region, drained affected nodes, and are working with the cloud provider on underlying AZ networking. We'll follow up with postmortem"
Devon: Reassigning follow-ups: Eng-SRE to verify cluster leader elections, Oncall-Net to follow cloud-provider ticket until root cause. Sam to validate logs and trace samples for user-facing error types.
Eng-SRE: Acknowledged; will run leader-election audit: `kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=route-controller -o wide` and check `controller_log_tail = /var/log/route-controller/current | grep election`
Oncall-Net: Cloud provider escalated to network ops; they identified transient MTU blackhole between AZs causing control-plane heartbeats to drop. They propose temporary route flapping suppression for 30m.
Maria: CDN cache purge complete, edge route cache flush applied, most clients now resolving to eu-west-1.
Sam: Confirming error budget impact: embeddings API burned ~0.07% of monthly quota in that window.
Lia: Handoff: I'm handing incident to second-shift SRE (Eng-SRE) at 1765440000 for overnight monitoring and postmortem prep. @Eng-SRE please keep oncall rotation updated.
Eng-SRE: Taking over. Will keep channel updated every 30m and start timeline capture.
Lia: Final immediate action items: (a) wait for cloud provider mitigation, (b) keep routing override until provider confirms AZ stability, (c) prepare postmortem draft and customer-notice.
Oncall-Net: Provider applied route suppression at 1765441200. Monitoring for re-elections and control-plane stability.
Sam: Thanks all. Reactions: :thumbsup: — current status: mitigated (forced routing + drains), watching for recurrence.
Lia: Closing the urgent paging loop. Moving channel to incident-update for PM + CS comms. Will add postmortem link when drafted. :white_check_mark:
